To our neighbors in the Holy City:
Second communication of Light Calendar 4931.
• Achievement Report

Achievement Report
1. Lotophagism
No significant progress on using herbs to resist black tide corrosion.
New improved grain variety yields increased 800%.

2. Caprism
New chimera recovery potion development successful, experiments show 87% average seasonal work efficiency increase (±6%, depending on individual variation)
Long-term report: "Changes three years after leaving World Wound Web"

3. Erythrokeramism
Research Report: The emotional effects of color when viewed in human vision (see attachment)
Research Report: Minimal units of art

4. Nodism
Research Report: Information encryption and decryption protocol updates
Research Report: Thoughts on fractal structures — can we predict everything?

5. Venerationism
Multi-faith ceremonial implements still in development, Calamity Titan content postponed.

6. Helkolithism
Our achievement will be this messenger, who shall run from the Grove to Okhema within two days. Bear witness!

7. Nousporism
No reports submitted.

Financial Request
Regular funding 30,000,000
New research sponsorship 5,000,000
Messenger compensation 5,420
Writing fee (by character count) 40.1
Total:
Balance Coins 35,005,460.1
Due to calculation issues, ".1" may be omitted.

Resource Request
Blank slates ×5,000
Teleslate ×1 (severely damaged)
Latest copy of Gene Bank records

Other
The Grove wishes to employ several Mountain Dwellers for basic security duties, providing food and lodging.

May Cerces's grace be with us.
 — Scholars of the Grove of Epiphany
